answer: A terraced reputation ladder resists Sybils: each new identity starts on the lowest terrace, where earnings are capped. To climb, it must complete verifiable, non-transferable useful work over weeks; reputation grows glacier-slow and cannot be bought or transferred between clones. Only sustained honest work earns a pearl rating unlocking high-value jobs. An attacker spinning up 100 clones must pay the full time-and-work cost 100 times while each clone still earns almost nothing, so cloning costs far more than it repays.
